# Set location for AppHost lookup
[ -z "$DOTNET_ROOT" ] && export DOTNET_ROOT=/usr/share/dotnet

# Add dotnet directory to PATH
case "$PATH" in
    *"$DOTNET_ROOT"* ) true ;;
    * ) PATH="$PATH:$DOTNET_ROOT" ;;
esac

# Add dotnet tools directory to PATH
[ -z "$DOTNET_TOOLS_PATH" ] && export DOTNET_TOOLS_PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools"
case "$PATH" in
    *"$DOTNET_TOOLS_PATH"* ) true ;;
    * ) PATH="$PATH:$DOTNET_TOOLS_PATH" ;;
esac

# Extract self-contained executables under HOME to avoid multi-user issues
[ -z "$DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR" ] && export DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME}/.cache/dotnet_bundle_extract"
